Views room photos and
descriptions; books a room
type or a specific room on
web or mobile.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Room photos and descriptions,
availability; books a room
type or a specific room.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Ordered room list with guest
wishes and defects; works
offline, sends updates when
Wi-Fi is back.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frame Rezerwacja + room
availability and status: the
only place that can take a
room for a night (one
transaction); 10-min hold for
unpaid bookings.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frames Housekeeping +
Servis tech: one queue for
cleaning and repairs,
priority from when the room
is needed next; API for cart
devices.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Board frame Synchronizacja +
calls to Payments: the only
caller of the legacy system;
outbox queue while legacy is
down, nightly data
reconciliation.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
One schema per service,
services never read another
service's schema; replica +
backups.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Existing system of record:
reservations, guest data,
prices, Payments (payments,
refunds, cancellations),
manager reports. Blocks a
room pool for us.
